judged_text: Email send failures are swallowed with console.log('Error sending AddGuestsEmails') — the error object is not logged and no failure is surfaced to the caller. When the mail provider call fails, the user still sees the 'Guests added' success toast and the log line contains no diagnostic detail, so operators cannot determine why guests never received invites.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, email sending is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, which discards `err` and always returns `{ message: "Guests added" }`. This means email provider failures produce no diagnostic detail and are not surfaced to the caller/UI (the UI success toast is triggered on mutation success), even though the primary action (adding guests to the booking) did succeed.
